source_title: Appian Marks Major Milestone in Supporting US Army Ammunition Modernization - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Initial release built in 110 days in Appian Defense Cloud to serve more than 10,000 global users across the Army
MCLEAN, Va. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Appian (NASDAQ: APPN ) today announced that the US Army fielded the initial release of the Total Army Combat and Training Munitions Information System (TACTMIS). Executed through the Army Enterprise Agreement (EA) , the team delivered TACTMIS in just 110 days from the contract award date.
Built on Appian Defense Cloud with Impact Level 5 (IL5) designation, TACTMIS modernizes how the Army plans, manages, and reports munitions for more than 10,000 global users. The system supports Army-wide readiness reporting, planning, programming, budgeting, and execution processes.
" TACTMIS represents an important milestone in the Army's broader modernization effort," said John Hinnant, Chief of Munitions, Headquarters, Department of the Army, Deputy Chief of Staff, G3/5/7. "This initial capability establishes the foundation for delivering new functionality more rapidly as mission requirements evolve, ensuring our ammunition management systems continue to support the needs of Soldiers in the field."
The new system is designed to reduce manual workload, improve data integrity, and accelerate business processes with automation. TACTMIS replaced disconnected emails, spreadsheets, and fragmented legacy workflows with a modern, cloud-based enterprise platform.
TACTMIS serves as the Army's authoritative source for managing munitions requirements, authorizations, forecasting, and expenditure reporting. It automates requirements calculations and centralizes authorization management, electronic request processing, expenditure reconciliation, and enterprise reporting.
Using Appian data fabric , TACTMIS orchestrates processes across existing Army and Department of War enterprise systems while ensuring data integrity. This increases visibility of munitions demand and usage across the Active Army, Army National Guard, Army Reserve, and joint partners.
TACTMIS also includes embedded agents that help users find records instantly based on contextual search across 14 operational grids. Agents can also answer questions using approved support and policy information, summarize forecast data, automate weekly briefings and reports.
The platform has seen rapid adoption. According to Appian data, agent use grew over 25-fold in the first 3 months of operation, driven primarily by personnel using assistants for daily operational tasks.
"Military readiness depends on getting critical resources to Soldiers quickly, accurately, and with complete accountability," said Jason Adolf, Senior Vice President, Public Sector Customer Success at Appian. "TACTMIS demonstrates how modern software can replace fragmented legacy processes with a system that gives Army teams a single, reliable view of munitions requirements, authorizations, and use. We're proud to support the Army as it builds a stronger digital foundation for ammunition readiness."
Using Appian, Army leaders and developers can easily refine processes and business rules as operational needs evolve, without lengthy redevelopment cycles. Planned future enhancements include a classified capability increment designed to support near-real-time combat munitions requirements and expenditure reporting.
The initial release of TACTMIS establishes the foundation for continuous expansion, process automation, integration, and modernization for the Army. Appian Defense Cloud provides a secure enterprise architecture to support the Army's vision to deliver a modern, scalable, and reliable system for commanders to support and protect Soldiers in the field.
